tools.name: credit_card_photo_instructions
tools.description:
Return safe capture guidance for upstream CR80 pixel picking.

    The image stays with the caller or upstream vision system; SmartScale only
    receives numeric pixel geometry.

tools.name: scale_objects_from_credit_card
tools.description:
Scale object pixel dimensions using a standard CR80 credit card reference.

    Args:
        image_id: Caller-defined source identifier; no image is uploaded.
        credit_card_pixel_width: Caller-supplied pixel width of a CR80-size card.
        objects: Objects to scale. Each object needs pixel

tools.name: describe
tools.description: Return SmartScale capabilities and input contract.

findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "scale_objects_from_credit_card" is 659 chars, far longer than this server's median (117). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.
